HILLSIDE ASSETS LIMITED is an international company focused on digital assets, financial markets, market research, and data-driven trading solutions. We are building a team of motivated specialists interested in understanding market behavior, identifying emerging trends, and developing practical expertise in a dynamic financial environment.

We are looking for a Market Specialist to support our market research and day-to-day analytical operations. This position is suitable for candidates at the beginning of their professional journey who are eager to learn, work with real market data, and develop their understanding of digital asset markets.

jobs.description:
Location: Remote / Worldwide

Employment Type: Freelance / Contract

Compensation: Pay per task

Equipment Required: Sony Alpha 1 II (Sony A1 II)

About the Role

micro1 is looking for professional photographers who own or have reliable access to a Sony Alpha 1 II camera to participate in a photography project supporting AI development.

Selected candidates will be responsible for capturing high-quality photographs of various objects across different environments, including indoor and outdoor locations, urban settings, and rural or natural surroundings.

This opportunity is ideal for photographers who have access to a variety of locations and can independently organize and execute photography assignments.
